newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks seen opening up on fresh buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks seen opening up on fresh buying.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to open up on Friday on fresh broad-based buying before the end of the financial year on June 30, dealers said.
The Karachi 100-index is expected to rise as some financial institutions have started year-end buying which will reflect their firms' strength, dealer Mohammad Ali said.

"The market is gaining activity and this sounds positive," he said. "Broad-based buying has emerged and this will keep the market stable. Core investments are still being chased at current prices and this may push the prices up."
